newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay Pacific adds flights to Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific adds flights to Vietnam.

text.p: Hong Kong and Hanoi are to be linked by four new evening flights a week operated under the Cathay Pacific Airways and Vietnam Airlines joint venture, Cathay said in a statement.

The four flights on Mondays, Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays brings the total number of flights per week to Hanoi to six, all operated by Vietnam Airlines under the new winter timetable which starts October 27.
"Vietnam is a rapidly expanding market. In May this year we launched an additional daily flight to Ho Chi Minh City," said William Ling, Cathay's south east Asian route manager.

Under the winter timetable there will be 18 flights a week to Vietnam from Hong Kong. An equal number of Cathy and Vietnam Airline planes will be used on the 12 scheduled flights each week to Ho Chi Minh City, a Cathay spokesman said in London. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
